name: Practice Loop
idea: A single kolam-inspired line returns around two seeds of knowledge, making repetition the structure of the mark.

name: Return by Steps
idea: An ascending stair folds into a generous return path, turning small deliberate advances into a recurring practice.

name: Tended Flame
idea: A quiet lamp frames learning as a flame sustained by attention rather than an answer handed over.

name: Review Mala
idea: A loop of tactile beads and one larger anchor bead makes scheduled review feel like returning to a familiar ritual.

name: Spaced Spiral
idea: A broad spiral revisits its center at widening intervals, expressing review that strengthens and expands understanding.

name: Connected Understanding
idea: Two continuous branches connect three knowledge nodes, suggesting understanding built through relationships rather than isolated answers.
